name: DescribeScheduledTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scheduled task belongs
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scheduled task list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task
parameters.help_zh: 执行定时任务的伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The scaling rule used when the scheduled task is triggered. This parameter is returned only when the scheduled task specifies a scaling rule
parameters.help_zh: 仅当定时任务指定了伸缩规则时，定时任务触发时使用的伸缩规则
parameters.name: scheduled_action

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled task to query
parameters.name: scheduled_task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the scheduled task to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询定时任务的名称
parameters.name: scheduled_task_name

parameters.help_en: The task name. Fuzzy match by keyword is supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，支持根据关键字模糊搜索
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the scheduled task. Valid values:

Daily: The scheduled task is executed every specified number of days.
Weekly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each week.
Monthly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each month.
Cron: The scheduled task is executed based on a specified cron expression
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的类型，取值范围：

Daily：每多少天重复执行一次定时任务。
Weekly：每周指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。
Monthly：每月内指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。
Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行定时任务
parameters.name: recurrence_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task.

This parameter is supported only when RecurrenceType is set to Weekly. You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). For example, the values for Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的数值。

仅支持当RecurrenceType为Weekly时指定此字段，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如，周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六的值依次为：0,1,2,3,4,5,6
parameters.name: recurrence_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the scheduled task is enabled.

true: The task is enabled.
false: The task is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务是否已启动。

true：任务已启动。
false：任务已停止
parameters.name: task_enabled

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scheduled tasks
